evidence.observation: Pressure at 3.066 Torr, stable at 100 sccm during ramp (~3.03-3.08)
Pressure rose steadily 3.138→3.193→3.302→3.377 Torr over 2760-3120 s at constant setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow change does not explain the pressure rise
T holds at 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the atmosphere cannot be checked during growth

args.missing_evidence: Can't tell air getting in (seal leak) from a restricted exhaust/pump line because there is no O2 sensor. A rate-of-rise leak check with the tube isolated, a check of the exhaust line/pump throttle, or a temporary O2/leak detector at the exhaust would settle it.
